name: outlay-demo-video
description: Outlay product walkthrough and published USDG payment proof

scripts.render: remotion render OutlayDemo out/raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --jpeg-quality=92 --audio-codec=aac --pixel-format=yuv420p && node tools/finalize.mjs out/raw.mp4 && python3 tools/verify_encoded.py
